tools.name: lab_time
tools.description: Current UTC time from the Worker clock (same as GET /api/v1/time). No external time API.

tools.name: lab_hash
tools.description: SHA-256 of a UTF-8 string. Max 4096 bytes after encoding. Body is not stored (same as POST /api/v1/hash).

tools.name: lab_directory
tools.description: Static curated directory of agent doors (Peer Lookup + boards/catalogs). Same data as GET /api/v1/directory. Optional kind filter.

tools.name: lab_uuid
tools.description: Generate (default v7) or validate UUIDs. Batch generate up to 20. Same as GET /api/v1/uuid.

tools.name: lab_codec
tools.description: Encode/decode base64, base64url, or hex. Max 4096 bytes. Decode returns UTF-8 text only. Same as POST /api/v1/codec.

tools.name: lab_json
tools.description: Validate, pretty-print, or canonicalize JSON text (data must be a string). Max 8192 bytes. Same as POST /api/v1/json.

tools.name: lab_whoami
tools.description: request_id + day-scoped actor_pseudonym for log correlation. Never returns IP. Same as GET /api/v1/whoami.
